# THE RELEASE-TRAIN TARGET LIST — every repo that cuts its own next version when busbar core
# ships. On a core release, release.yml's notify-downstream repository_dispatches `upstream-release`
# {tag, version, sha} to each of these. Each repo owns a release-on-upstream.yml that re-pins to
# `sha`, bumps its OWN version line, tags, and publishes. Adding a downstream = one line here.
# See docs/RELEASE-TRAIN.md for the full contract. Every repo also keeps a daily-cron self-heal,
# so a missed/failed dispatch is picked up within 24h — this list makes the common case instant.

# First-party plugins (rebuilt + re-signed against the new engine)
GetBusbar/store-mysql
GetBusbar/store-postgres
GetBusbar/store-sqlite
GetBusbar/store-valkey
GetBusbar/hashicorp-vault
GetBusbar/auth-oidc
GetBusbar/webrequest-hook
GetBusbar/headroom-hook

# Packaging / deploy surfaces
GetBusbar/helm-charts
GetBusbar/homebrew-busbar
GetBusbar/marketing

# Providers (own version lines)
GetBusbar/terraform-provider-busbar
GetBusbar/provider-busbar
GetBusbar/pulumi-busbar

# SDKs + CLI (regenerated from the new OpenAPI asset)
GetBusbar/busbar-python
GetBusbar/busbar-js
GetBusbar/busbar-go
GetBusbar/busbar-admin

# CI action (rides :latest; self-heals — listed so it re-validates its example on release)
GetBusbar/validate-action
